mapper.select: SELECT sh.id, sh.title, sh.purpose, sh.total_target_count, sh.success_count, sh.fail_count, sh.status, sh.scheduled_at, sh.completed_at, sh.created_at FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(sh.completed_at, sh.scheduled_at, sh.created_at) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT st.status AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM send_target st WHERE NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY st.status

SELECT 'H-' || sh.id AS id, COALESCE(sh.title, '제목 없음') AS title, COALESCE(channel_rows.channel_names, '-') AS channel, CASE sh.status WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN '대기' WHEN 'PREPARING' THEN '준비 중' WHEN 'SENDING' THEN '발송 중' WHEN 'SCHEDULED' THEN '예약' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '완료' WHEN 'SENT' THEN '완료' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '실패' ELSE COALESCE(sh.status, '-') END AS status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(target_rows.requested, sh.total_target_count, 0) = 0 AND sh.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'SENT') THEN 100 WHEN COALESCE(target_rows.requested, sh.total_target_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(target_rows.processed, COALESCE(sh.success_count, 0) + COALESCE(sh.fail_count, 0), 0) / COALESCE(target_rows.requested, sh.total_target_count)) * 100 ) END AS progress, COALESCE(target_rows.requested, sh.total_target_count, 0) AS requested, COALESCE(target_rows.processed, COALESCE(sh.success_count, 0) + COALESCE(sh.fail_count, 0), 0) AS processed FROM send_history sh LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shr.send_history_id, LISTAGG(c.channel_type, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY shr.priority_order) AS channel_names FROM send_history_routing shr JOIN channel c ON c.id = shr.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(shr.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY shr.send_history_id ) channel_rows ON channel_rows.send_history_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.send_history_id, COUNT(*) AS requested, SUM(CASE WHEN st.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processed FROM send_target st WHERE NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY st.send_history_id ) target_rows ON target_rows.send_history_id = sh.id WHERE NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN sh.status IN ('QUEUED', 'PREPARING', 'SENDING', 'SCHEDULED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(sh.scheduled_at, sh.completed_at, sh.created_at) DESC, sh.id DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY
